note: OpenAPI: Form<T> on GET/HEAD is documented as query parameters (axum reads the query string there); TypedHeader<T> header names come from T (known headers::* wire names, otherwise T in kebab-case) instead of the argument binding, so TypedHeader(_) is no longer dropped; an internally tagged newtype variant over a closed (deny_unknown_fields) or map payload merges the tag into the payload object instead of an allOf that rejected the tag
